newsitem.title: USA: WLR to buy back 10 percent of shares.
newsitem.headline: WLR to buy back 10 percent of shares.

text.p: WLR Foods Inc., known for its Wampler Foods brand turkey and chicken products, said Monday it has agreed to buy back 10 percent of its outstanding stock for more than $17.7 million in a private deal with Cuddy Farms Inc.

The stake of 1,774,999 common shares will be bought for $10 per share in three stages. About half of the shares were purchased upon signing of the agreement, 25 pecent will be purchased in March and the other 25 percent in late June.
The stock will be held in trust and will not be available for public trading until August 1998, in an effort to enhance shareholder value for the long term, WLR said.
When completed, these transactions will eliminate the Broadway, Va.-based company's obligation under a share repurchase agreement with Cuddy Farms and its lenders.
WLR, which also sells ice under the Cassco label, said it had 17,783,009 million outstanding shares as of Dec. 28.
WLR's stock added 50 cents to $13.125 on Nasdaq at midday.
